items.title: 9.3.1.2 Customer Surveys and Focus Groups (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of surveys and focus groups (PDF 213).

items: Customer surveys online, phone ya aamne saamne bohat se gahakon se maloomat jama karte hain; bakery kholne se pehle parosiyon se poochein ke kaunsi cheezein chahte, kab khareedte aur kitna kharch karte hain.
Focus groups chhote, mukhtalif group ko product par tafseeli guftagu ke liye jama karte hain; shurakaa roti aur pastries chakh kar pasand, na-pasand aur behtari par baat karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Focus group survey se kab behtar hoga?
blocks.explanation: Jab jawab ginne ki bajaye samajhna ho ke log aisa kyun mehsoos karte hain, maslan naya product chakh kar un ka tafseeli rad-e-amal.

items: Surveys: bohat log, munazzam sawal. Focus groups: chand log, gehri guftagu.
